claims.value: <cell line>_<experiment> (WM-266-4_F1, WM115_F1, WM-266-4_F2, WM115_F2, WM115_R1, WM-266-4_R1)
claims.evidence: Three SILAC experiments deposited as file prefixes WM_F1, WM_F2, WM_R1 (21 SCX fractions each, -0..-20), each searched separately in MaxQuant (separate rar per experiment; summary.txt experiment names F1, F2, R1). PRIDE protocol describes a forward (F) and a reverse (R) SILAC experiment; F1/F2 are the two forward replicates. One source per (cell line, SILAC mixture).

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[cell line] + factor value[cell line] rows 1-84 (F1, F2)
claims.value: F1, F2: SILAC light = WM-266-4, SILAC heavy = WM115
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: "In the forward SILAC experiment, the lysate of light-labeled WM-266-4 cells and that of the heavy-labeled WM-115 cells were combined at 1:1 ratio". Data check: paper reports TBC1D4, TBC1D14, TBC1D16, TBC1D7, TBC1D10A up and TBC1D24 down in WM-266-4 vs WM-115; deposited normalized H/L log2 in F1/F2: TBC1D7 -1.43/-1.16, TBC1D4 -2.17/-2.36, TBC1D16 -1.55/-1.83, TBC1D10A -0.71/-0.78, TBC1D24 +0.79/+0.86 -> heavy = WM-115 (lower TBC1D7). F1 vs F2 log2 H/L Pearson +0.922 (n=5470).

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[cell line] + factor value[cell line] rows 85-126 (R1)
claims.value: R1: SILAC light = WM115, SILAC heavy = WM-266-4
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: "the heavy-labeled WM-266-4 cell lysate was mixed equally with the light-labeled WM-115 cell lysate in the reverse SILAC experiment". Data check: R1 log2 H/L TBC1D4 +1.77, TBC1D14 +0.70, TBC1D16 +1.19, TBC1D10A +0.44, TBC1D24 -0.84 (TBC1D7 quantified by 1 ratio only, NaN); R1 vs F1 / F2 Pearson -0.863 / -0.875 -> label swap confirmed.

Paper: "5955 (81%) were quantified in at least two replicates of SILAC-labeling experiments" - the three mixtures are separate SILAC-labeling experiments, each separately SCX-fractionated (21 fractions each) and searched. Whether F1 and F2 came from independent cultures is not stated explicitly (Methods in unretrievable SI); treated as independent labelling experiments.

Raw method: scan event 1 "FTMS + c norm res=60000 o(350.0-1500.0)", events 2-21 "ITMS + c norm Dep MS/MS Most intense ion from (1)" ... 20th (top-20 DDA).
Raw method: "Activation Type: CID" for each dependent MS/MS event.
Raw method: "Normalized Coll. Energy: 35.0".
MS/MS events are ITMS on the LTQ Velos linear ion trap.
PRIDE protocol: "digested with trypsin" (FASP). MaxQuant summary.txt Protease = Trypsin/P (search rule; batch rule 2: digestion enzyme recorded).
PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol: "off-line strong cation exchange (SCX) fractionation ... PolySulfoethyl A SCX column ... Twenty-one fractions".
parameters.txt (MaxQuant 1.3.0.5, identical in all three searches): "MS/MS tol. (ITMS) 0.5 Da"; the MS/MS spectra are ITMS (raw).

comment[reduction reagent] / comment[alkylation reagent] = not available: PRIDE says proteins were "reduced, alkylated" (and the search has fixed Carbamidomethyl) but no reagent is named in any retrieved source.

characteristics[biological replicate]: F1 and F2 are treated as independent SILAC-labelling experiments (replicates 1 and 2) and R1 as replicate 3; independence of the cultures is not stated explicitly in any retrieved text.
